sloka: विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणा अप्रतिमा भुवि ।अभिशापात् अभूत् तात कपित्वे काम रूपिणी ॥४-६६-९॥
transliteration: vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu rūpeṇā apratimā bhuvi ।abhiśāpāt abhūt tāta kapitve kāma rūpiṇī ॥4-66-9॥

translations.english: 'O dear she was famous in the three worlds, peerless in beauty and could change form at her free will. She was born of a monkey on this land by dint of a curse.
